items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023

ctx.x: Yes. Yes. A lot of — well I’ll say most studio recordings, you know, they record the rhythm section first and then they record the horns, and then they record the strings, you know separately, and you know it’s for many reasons, especially including leakage. But you know you concentrate on the rhythm, you get that right, concentrate on the horns, get that right, concentrate on the strings, get that right. And you know vocals are always separate too. Sometimes they put the vocal on first because you need to see…
Of course. Oh yeah. What a phenomenal musician and a nice guy.
